type: High-density causal chain / genealogical infographics poster
goal: Use a highly saturated image to showcase the milestones of large language models and multimodal achievements from 2017 to 2026, allowing readers to quickly glance at the stage divisions.

style.aesthetic: The timeline is a bold glowing line, nodes are brand dots + model abbreviations, supplemented with microchips/data scroll line art, overall leaning towards deep space blue + electric purple tech style but keeping readability
style.color_palette: Deep space indigo, electric purple, signal cyan, warning amber, white text
style.language: Chinese main narrative + English abbreviations as subtitles.

header.main_title_cn: From Transformer to inference models: Evolution map of large language models 2017-2026.
header.main_title_en: LANDMARKS IN LLM AND MULTIMODAL RESEARCH (2017–2026)
header.subtitle: Non-exhaustive list: Focus on published papers and mainstream routes, without implying commercial rankings

centerpiece.description: The center features a serpentine branching timeline, with 'Attention is All You Need' from 2017 on the left, branching to the right into the GPT series, BART/T5 series, open-source LLaMA/Mistral series, and multimodal CLIP-Flamingo-Gemini types, ending with a small question mark labeled 'on-device / memory / long context / test-time compute inference' for 2025-2026.
centerpiece.highlight: Cyan green pulse flows along the main line, with bright markers at nodes such as '2018 GPT-1', '2019 BERT Bidirectional', '2020 GPT-3', '2022 Instruct/RLHF', '2023 Long Context + Tool Use', '2024 Open Source MoE + Multimodal', '2025–2026 Reasoning + Agents'

sections.count: Label (one side of the image shows a corner roll indication): original wort concentration, shelf life, manufacturer name, excessive drinking warning, QR code tracing outline.
items: 01 2017 Transformer Self-Attention Replaces RNN Sequence Bottleneck

10 2025+ test-time reasoning + agents + code execution: SWE-bench and other hard benchmarks

components: 1 small icon (keyboard, weight block, eye shape)
section_block_style.alignment: Odd numbers on the upper side of the timeline, even numbers on the lower side, avoid text crossing the main trunk

footer.core_message: The history of technology is not 'one model smarter', but the simultaneous migration of computing power, data, algorithms, and product feedback.
footer.core_message_en: Progress couples capacity, data, alignment, and deployment — not a single FLOP number.

must_keep: No fictitious specific market share or unpublished parameter quantities, only stage qualitative descriptions
Year nodes consistent with main title 2017-2026
avoid: Use real identifiable trademarks as the main visual of the entire image
More than 4 main colors will cause printing dirtiness
